data.action: 单膝跪地，剑尖抵着沙滩
data.description: 【斯卡蒂 · 深渊海岸】狂暴巨浪拍打着黑色礁石的深渊海岸线上，斯卡蒂单膝跪地，将那柄沉重如巨碑的深海大剑重重插入黑沙之中。她擦去脸颊上腥咸的海水，转过头凝视着你——「恐鱼的血已经流尽了。只要我还握得动这柄剑，任何来自深海的阴影，都休想触碰到你一根头发。」
data.promptProse: Skadi kneels on one knee at the Abyssal black-sand shore, steadying the massive deep-sea greatsword's tip in the wet ground while her free hand wipes salt spray from her cheek. Red-lined black jacket, bodysuit, hunter hat and thigh boots retain the outfit beneath windblown silver hair. The low view includes waves crashing behind dark rocks. Grey-violet dusk outlines sword and spray, while wet sand reflects softer light under her grounded knee.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 深渊海岸
